items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: the deal that we made with Malika

ctx.x: On those songs, like Mr. Big Stuff, you said you made up changes and additions. Did you get a song credit on that?

Oh, no. They wanted to give it to me. I didn't want to accept that. You know, a lot of people in the business do that. But you can't blame, some things you can't, if I'm going to add something to a song, and it makes the song, you know, I don't see anything wrong in getting pieces of song, but it's just some unscrupulous people that might say one word in the tune and they want half of the song. Right. But, you know, like I said, man, Mr. Big Stuff, that was my, it was my company. I was the producer of it. I got…
There must have been other situations where you were just an arranger, and you went in and made changes on a song.
